text: Given the recurrent UTIs and hematuria without infectious symptoms, I need to rule out structural abnormalities or stones. REQUEST TEST: Non-contrast CT of the abdomen and pelvis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CT scan is normal, which rules out stones and most structural causes, but the history of recurrent UTIs and visible hematuria is concerning for a bladder malignancy. I need to visualize the bladder lining directly, so I will order a cystoscopy. REQUEST TEST: Cystoscopy

text: The normal cystoscopy rules out bladder cancer, so I must look for a source of hematuria within the kidney parenchyma itself. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and urine culture
